candidates.explanation: After a successful password reset, the code only updates the user's password. It never deletes the user's existing sessions (for example with sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id })). The already-signed-in phone keeps a valid session, and AuthService.refreshToken only checks the session id and hash, so it can still renew its login. The authenticated password-change path in AuthService.update (around line 469) does invalidate other sessions, but the reset path doesn't.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after usersService.update, call await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) to revoke all of the user's sessions so every device must sign in again.
